Author: NightmareXIV
Name: Splatoon
Punchline: Scriptable overlay engine for drawing mechanics, markers, and indicators in real-time
Description:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!

Name: Macro Chain Redux

- Added: You can now click on the group header in the Type filter to filter for either all Fieldcraft, Tradecraft or Grand Company Leves.
- Added: When GatherBuddy is installed, the Queue and Recipe Tree now display GatherBuddys tooltip on fish and spearfish, including info about the Bait, Time and Weather restrictions and the next uptimes.  
  - Please note that GatherBuddy uses the client language, not Dalamuds UI language like LeveHelper. It's out of my control.
- Fixed: Some gatherables did not show up in the Queue.

Regarding the Levemete filter

The game's database doesn't list which Levemete issues which Levequests and multiple old NPCs also rotate their Levequests when you complete one.

I used to scrape a wiki to gather this data, but two weeks ago, we added Levequest issuer tracking to the Tracky plugin and already have more entries than the wiki provided!

Some entries that I could confirm through another wiki are still missing, so manually added those back in for now.

If you'd like to help us, please install the Tracky plugin and enable uploads in its settings.

Thank you! :)

Author: The Combat Reborn Team
Name: Rotation Solver Reborn
Description:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

This means almost all the information available in one frame in combat, including the status of all players in the party, the status of any hostile targets, skill cooldowns, the MP and HP of characters, the location of characters, casting status of the hostile target, combo, combat duration, player level, etc.
Then, it will highlight the best action on the hot bar, or help you to click on it.
It is designed for `general combat`, not for savage or ultimate. Use it carefully.
Punchline: Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

Author: The Redheaded Witch, WillWolf76
Name: Fashion Report Calculator / Dye Finder
Punchline: Know your Fashion Report points on the spot and help crowdsource new items and dyes!
Description:
This is the new and improved Fashion Report System. This plugin will allow you to open a window that will show you what your fashion report status is vs the current week's theme.

There are a few parts to this. Since the only way to get Fashion Report for the week to my knowledge is speaking to Masked Rose after Tuesdays reset, this plugin takes the first person who does talk to him and updates everyone else. So only one person per week needs to speak to Masked Rose.

You can click on a theme and pull all the known items for that theme for that specific slot. You also get a very detailed breakdown of how much points you are getting based on what you are currently wearing.

The plugin also stores the attempts of those using the mod (just the data from fashioncheck, no user information) so that we can figure out the dyes faster and share information faster. The information in this table is wiped every week since once we discover the dyes, it is useless.

I still have more upgrades to do, including adding a dye window and the window that will help calculate the weekly dyes. I already have an idea of how I want to write them, so it shouldn't take me too long. If you have suggestions on how I can upgrade this, please share with me on github!

Credit for the program goes to it's original creator, WillWolf76, who wrote this for me originally.

When this plugin updates the database, it also updates my Discord Bot which you can set up to post fashion report each week. It's set to update on Tuesdays and Fridays (week start and dye information added). Link to add the Discord Bot is in the about section.
Changelog: Fixed some minor bugs.

Author: Legends of the Game
Name: Tales of Milestones
Description: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
Punchline: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.
Changelog:
Tales of Milestones:
- Food from your accepted quests. The /tm food window has a new section, "From accepted quests". It lists each quest in your journal that gives food, and the role that each meal suits. A reward that you choose from is under "Pick one:".
- Eye on the quest turn-in window. When a quest reward is food, the turn-in window shows an eye beside "Reward". Click the eye to open /tm food before you choose your reward. The eye opens nothing by itself, and it changes nothing in the game window. To turn it off, use the new setting in either Settings window.
- Text follows your UI theme. The game-styled windows use the text colour of the theme that you selected in the game. Text is now easy to read on the Light, Clear White and Clear Pink themes. Headings are larger. The Bonuses tab shows each food's role as the game's role icon and as a word.
- Language for dates. A new Language setting in both Settings windows selects English, German, French or Japanese. The default follows Dalamud, then the game. Only dates use it at this time.
- News feed date. Active Events shows the time and date when the news feed was last updated, with the month as a name.
- Shorter event names. Active Events shows "Keybound Brawler", not the announcement title "Keybound Brawler Arrives October 28!".
- News checks. The plugin checks the news feed on the feed's own 6-hour schedule: every 15 minutes in the hour after an update, otherwise every 30 minutes.
- Credits. The Credits tab now names skyborn-industries (lodestonenews.com) and aers (FFXIVClientStructs).
- Fix: a meal with no combat stat no longer shows as DPS food. This includes Bacon Broth, the eight resistance Drops, Kingcake and Tailor-made Eel Pie.
- Fix: the download is smaller. The plugin zip no longer contains copies of Dalamud's own files, so it went from 12.7 MB to 1.3 MB.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto PVP LB
Description: Fires your PvP Limit Break for you when an enemy's HP drops below a configurable threshold.
Punchline: Your PvP Limit Break, fired for you.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto Mahjong Solver
Description: Reads Doman Mahjong, computes the best discard and call, shows a suggestion overlay, and can play for you.
Punchline: Doman Mahjong, solved for you.
Changelog: Rebranded to Auto Mahjong Solver. Same plugin (InternalName Mahjong.Plugin.Dalamud), so existing installs update in place.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto Daily Tribes
Description: Does your daily allied tribe quests for you: tick the tribes, the plugin handles the rest.
Punchline: Daily allied tribe quests, done for you.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto FATE Grind
Description: Farms FATEs for you: tick the zones, and the plugin teleports in, finds active FATEs, and runs them in a loop until your target is met.
Punchline: FATEs, farmed for you.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto PVP Series Grind
Description: Grinds PvP Series Malmstones in Crystalline Conflict Casual or Ranked Matches, or Frontline, with preview infantry support for Rival Wings (Hidden Gorge). Queues and plays until your goal is met.
Punchline: PvP Series, grinded for you.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Aetherphone
Description: An in-game smartphone that puts everything you do into a single window: one device, endless things to do.
Punchline: A smartphone, built for you.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto Hunt Grinder
Description: Clears your hunt bills for you: tick the daily and weekly bills you want, and the plugin picks them up at the hunt board, finds every mark, and fights it until each bill is done.
Punchline: Hunt bills, cleared for you.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto Hunt Train
Description: Rides hunt trains for you: hears a train being called anywhere in your region, travels to the start aetheryte on that world, follows the conductor's flags from mark to mark, and lands a hit on every A rank before the crowd deletes it.
Punchline: Hunt trains, ridden for you.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto Sightseeing Log
Description: Fills in your Sightseeing Log for you: tick the vistas you want, and the plugin travels to each one, waits for its hour and weather, performs the emote the log asks for, and moves on until every vista is logged.
Punchline: Sightseeing vistas, logged for you.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto Triple Triad Grind
Description: Collects every Triple Triad card NPCs can give you: pick the cards you are missing, and the plugin travels to each NPC, builds a deck for its rules, plays until your cards drop, registers them, and moves on.
Punchline: Every NPC card, collected for you.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto Treasure Maps
Description: Works through your timeworn maps for you: deciphers each map in your bags, travels to the dig spot, digs up the coffer, fights off its guards and opens it, then moves on to the next map. When your bags run dry it can gather the daily timeworn map as a Miner or Botanist and buy more on the market board under your price caps and gil budget.
Punchline: Treasure maps, dug up for you.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto Shopper
Description: Buys your market board shopping list for you: plans the cheapest route through Universalis prices across the worlds you allow, travels between them with Lifestream, walks to the market board, buys whole listings within your price caps, and confirms every purchase.
Punchline: Your market board shopping list, bought for you.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto GC Supply
Description: Delivers your Grand Company supply and provisioning requests for you: reads the day's requests, buys what is missing through Auto Shopper, then travels to your Personnel Officer and hands in the ones you chose, confirming every delivery.
Punchline: Grand Company supply and provisioning, delivered for you.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto House Lottery
Description: Enters housing lotteries for you: pick an empty plot on the map or build a shortlist, and the plugin travels there, enters the lottery, then checks the result and collects your refund or claims your house.
Punchline: Housing lotteries, entered for you.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto Seller
Description: Sells through your retainers for you: set what to sell and the lowest price you accept, and the plugin visits each retainer at a summoning bell, compares market prices, reprices and lists your items without ever going below that price, and records every sale.
Punchline: Your retainer listings, sold for you.

Author: XeldarAlz
Name: Auto Keybound Brawler
Description: Plays Keybound Brawler's typing for you: reads the phrases above the enemies, sends the most urgent one in after as long as typing it would take, or types it into the input bar, with adjustable speed and a humanizer.
Punchline: Keybound Brawler, typed for you.

Author: nxships
Name: PlayerNexusTracker
Description:
Track players you meet in FFXIV — who they are, when you ran into them, how their characters change over time. A focused social tracker built on the NexusKit framework.

Per-player detail view with Summary, Equipment, Class/Jobs, Achievements, Free Company, Encounters, History and Notes tabs. Optional enrichment from Lodestone (gear, FC link, achievement progress) and FFXIVCollect (mounts, minions, full achievement catalog). Live throttled refresh queue keeps external data fresh without hammering either service.

Configurable chat and toast notifications when players you've seen before change — rename, server transfer, Free Company join/leave/switch, achievement growth, refresh failures. Per-event filtering and history grouping so the chat doesn't drown you.

Powerful player-filter language with live preview to slice your list however you want; encounter history scoped per duty and content type; optional bridges to other Dalamud plugins (Lifestream world-travel, more to come).

Local-first: all data lives in a single SQLite file under your XIVLauncher config. Automated weekly maintenance keeps it tidy. English and German localization.
Punchline: Track every adventurer you meet in Eorzea.
FeedbackMessage:
Please send feedback over to GitHub instead of using this dialog — the form there lets you pick the right category (Bug report, Feature request, or General question via Discussions) and asks for the context we need to act on the report (plugin version, repro steps, etc).

Open the chooser at:
https://github.com/NexusFFXIV/PlayerNexusTracker/issues/new/choose

Note: text you type in this Dalamud dialog goes to the Dalamud team aggregator and does not reach the plugin author directly.
